blurb: Guests can rent pontoon boats for all-day pleasure use on the water east of the Iron Workers Memorial Bridge. The marina offers moorage slips for pleasure craft from 12 to 85 feet, with transient moorage available up to 65 feet depending on availability. The location is near the village of Deep Cove, providing access to local shops, restaurants, and outdoor activities including hiking and exploring Indian Arm.
extraNote: 24 hour cancellation required · Deposit of $750.00 VISA or Mastercard for boat rentals · No overnight rentals · No moving of materials including furniture and construction · No fishing or crabbing allowed · Parking available for one car per rental only · Must remain east of Iron Workers Memorial Bridge (Second Narrows Bridge)
